meta.title: Sponsorship price sheet
meta.prepared_note: Reach figures are historical medians with their sources and dates; you pay only for impressions actually measured.

pricing.billing: Within 30 days after the sponsored week runs you receive a report with the measured impressions per placement and the invoice, never above your cap. Payable by card or bank transfer.

how_it_works: $25 per 1,000 verified impressions: unique email opens, podcast downloads and video views.
You pay after the promotion runs, against the measured numbers, never before.
You set a cap in advance: the invoice can never exceed it, even if a video takes off.
One sponsor per week, and we write the copy for you to approve.

measurement.newsletter: Unique opens of each sponsored edition as reported by beehiiv, counted 7 days after the send
measurement.podcast: Downloads of the sponsored episode in its first 30 days, as measured by Podtrac
measurement.youtube: Views of the sponsored video in its first 30 days, as reported by YouTube Studio

newsletter.name: Newsletter sponsor box
newsletter.format: A highlighted box at the top of one edition: a bold headline, two or three short paragraphs and your call to action with links. We draft it, you approve it.
newsletter.cadence: Two editions most weeks: the main article on Thursday and One Helpful Idea earlier in the week, each sent to the engaged part of the list.

podcast.name: Podcast host read
podcast.format: About 60 seconds read by Spencer Greenberg within the first minute of the episode, with your link in the show notes.
podcast.cadence: Clearer Thinking with Spencer Greenberg: a new episode most weeks.

youtube.name: YouTube host read
youtube.format: 20 to 30 seconds read by Spencer inside that week's video on his channel (research explainers of about 10 minutes), with your link in the description.
youtube.cadence: One video most weeks through November and December.

packages.name: Sponsor of the week (exclusive)
packages.what: Sponsor box in both newsletter editions that week, the podcast read and the YouTube read

packages.name: Newsletter + podcast week
packages.what: Sponsor box in both newsletter editions that week and the podcast read (for weeks whose video slot is taken)

podcast.source: Planning figure used in Clearer Thinking's October 2026 proposals, from the show's hosting dashboard. Episode counts from the RSS feed on 2026-11-02.
podcast.public_note: The show was downloaded more than 300,000 times in 2024 across 52 episodes (Clearer Thinking's 2024 year in review), about 5,800 per episode released that year.

youtube.window: Uploads from July 1 to October 31, 2026; views are lifetime totals on 2026-11-02

availability.note: One sponsor per week. Weeks are labelled by their Monday; the newsletter's main edition goes out on Thursday. Giving Tuesday is December 1, 2026.

weeks.channels: All channels, every week from January 2027
weeks.label: From Jan 4, 2027

process: Pick a week and tell us what to promote and where to send people. Your own tracking link is best.
We draft the copy for every placement (newsletter box, podcast read, video read) and send it for your approval, usually within a few days. You can edit anything; nothing runs without your sign-off.
Lead time: final copy two weeks before the sponsored week, because Spencer records the podcast and video reads ahead of publication. A newsletter-only placement needs one week.
Report and invoice within 30 days after the week runs, with the measured impressions per placement. The invoice never exceeds your cap. Payable by card or bank transfer.
fine_print: Clearer Thinking only promotes organizations, products and services it considers legitimate and a good fit for its readers, and sponsored placements are labelled as such.
Appearing as a guest on the podcast is an editorial decision made by Spencer and is never part of a sponsorship.
Unique opens are the figure beehiiv reports. As with every email platform, they include opens registered automatically by Apple Mail Privacy Protection.
Reach figures are historical medians, not guarantees. You pay for the impressions actually measured, up to your cap.

newsletter.source: beehiiv API, confirmed posts; same-day sends grouped into one edition; regular editions = recipients >= 200,000, open rate >= 15%, not a tool, workshop or coaching promo
